about: One set of the camera switches; the game keeps four of them (Ext.Utils.GetGlobalSwitches().CameraSwitches). TargetSnapDistance is how far a target may be for the camera to glide: beyond it the game cuts behind a black screen. MaxDistFromChar is the leash: how far from the controlled character the camera may go.

evidence.says: the header Components/Camera.h of Script Extender declares the struct CameraGlobalSwitches (0x194 bytes); the name the game gives the type is not known
all four sets read TargetSnapDistance 50 and MaxDistFromChar 50 on the level Basic_Level_A
reported from the study of the camera focus, not read again here: 45 m glides and 52 m fades; a focus at 72 m settles short until MaxDistFromChar is raised in all four
